notes: Rebuilt all seven armor manufacturer passives while keeping the existing base AC progression for the first balance pass.
ForgeLine ANCHOR PLATING grants +Mk AC against ranged weapon attacks after a turn with no movement; the runtime tracks movement and shows a BRACED state until the wearer's next turn.
Bastion TAKE THE BULLET removes up to Mk base weapon damage dice from firearm hits using d8-or-smaller class dice; flat bonuses and separate special damage are preserved.
Jade Arc THERMAL FARADAY now grants fire resistance; Mk.I-II gain advantage against EMP saves, while Mk.III-V are immune to EMP effects.
Corvus NEURAL ISOLATION remains +1/+1/+2/+2/+3 to Quickhack saves.
Vektor GRENADE NULL removes Dexterity contribution and grants immunity to direct grenade damage/effects/scans/forced movement; environmental smoke still obscures normally.
Helix KINETIC SYNC grants +5/+10/+15/+20/+25 ft walking Speed only while a Helix firearm is actively equipped.
Kurohane GHOSTWEAVE remains full Dexterity to AC plus +1/+1/+2/+2/+3 Stealth.
Completed a 1-100 armor power audit across all 35 armor pieces and repriced each Mk band by relative power while preserving Mk.I-V as the shop-tier progression.
Grenade runtime 1.4.0 now respects Vektor grenade immunity and Jade EMP immunity/fire resistance, including grenade damage-over-time ticks.
